collection.description: A child hears two adults disagree about how to prepare a feast.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) hears two adults disagree about how to prepare a feast.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a caregiver, says kind people can want different things.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that disagreement need not end friendship.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The adults prepare two dishes when supplies allow.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The adults agree to take turns choosing recipes.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) proposes an impossible plan, and the adults explain why.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns that shouting is not necessary to disagree.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) sees the adults apologize for speaking sharply.
